title: Covering
style: cinematic horror film still, dramatic moody lighting with the subject clearly visible and centered, old brick adult night school after dark, flickering fluorescent classrooms and long empty hallways, chalk dust in the air, sickly green and sodium orange tones, adults only, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, subject clearly visible, no text, no watermark
caption:
Part 1. Nobody hired the substitute. Everyone remembers him. 🍎

Original fiction. Part 2 tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: The man teaching Carla Dunn's class was never hired. And every one of her students knew his name.
scenes.image: a man in a grey suit standing at a chalkboard in a dim night-school classroom, his back turned

scenes.narration: Carla teaches evening English at the Eastgate Adult Learning Center. Twenty grown-ups, tired from day jobs, learning to write essays at seven at night.
scenes.image: tired adult students at old wooden desks in a fluorescent-lit classroom at night

scenes.narration: One Tuesday, she's stuck behind a jackknifed truck. She calls the office. Cancel my class. They say they will.
scenes.image: woman in a car at night stuck in traffic, red taillights reflecting on wet glass

scenes.narration: She gets there at quarter past eight to grab her papers. Her classroom light is on.
scenes.image: a single lit classroom window in a dark brick school building at night

scenes.narration: Through the door window, she sees a man at the board. Grey suit. Grey tie. Chalk in his hand.
scenes.image: view through a small door window of a man in a grey suit writing on a chalkboard

scenes.narration: Her students are taking notes. All of them. Even Dale, who has never taken a note in his life.
scenes.image: adult students bent over their desks writing intently, heads bowed, fluorescent light

scenes.narration: She opens the door. He doesn't turn around. He says, you're late, Miss Dunn. I've covered for you.
scenes.image: a thin man in a grey suit half in shadow, chalk between his fingers, chalk dust in the air

scenes.narration: Next morning she calls the office. No substitute was booked. Nobody named Grey has ever worked there.
scenes.image: an empty school office at dawn, a desk phone and dusty filing cabinets

scenes.narration: So she asks her students. And they all smile the same smile. Mr. Grey, they say. He always covers for us.
scenes.image: a row of adult night students smiling the same eerie smile under flickering lights

scenes.narration: Carla has taught that class for six years. She has never heard the name. And on her desk, she finds a stick of grey chalk, and a note. See you Thursday.
scenes.image: a single stick of grey chalk lying on a scratched wooden teacher's desk in an empty classroom
